deferral.reason: No accepted portable import format, Android exporter, measured bottleneck or demonstrated Rust production consumer exists; the only parser candidate is a synthetic preview prototype.
deferral.consequences: No Rust code or dependency is adopted; Kotlin/native ownership and existing identities remain unchanged.
deferral.reconsideration_trigger: Reopen after a qualified cross-platform app workflow selects a portable format with a real Android and Apple consumer.
